Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly assumed that OSU referred to Oklahoma State University instead of Oregon State University even after the WebSurfer correctly identified William J. Ripple as affiliated with Oregon State University. This led to initial confusion about the mascot related to the incorrect institution (Pistol Pete for Oklahoma State University). The Planner should have thoroughly verified and consolidated the information provided by WebSurfer before concluding which university was linked to William J. Ripple. This pattern aligns with similar errors where agents fail to consolidate intermediary results into a coherent answer, choosing instead to rely on incorrect or contextually ambiguous information.
